content: The organizer provides a speech translation corpus extracting from the TED talk (ST-TED), which consists of raw English wave files, English transcriptions, and aligned German translations. The corpus contains 272 hours of English speech with 171k segments. We split 2k segments from the corpus as dev set and tst2010, tst2013, tst2014, tst2015 are used as test sets.
